local_review.finding_body: `AbstractJdkValueExtractorTest` and `OrmAnnotationDescriptorInnerJdkCreatorTest` obtained annotations by reflectively looking up and invoking `AnnotatedElement.getAnnotation`. That unnecessary test-side reflection violated the no-reflection-shortcuts rule in `FS-test-contract.2.1`; the annotation instance can be obtained through the normal public annotation API without changing the tested Hibernate Models behavior.
local_review.finding_title: Test-side reflection bypasses the annotation API
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the reflective `getMethod(...).invoke(...)` helpers with direct `AnnotatedElement.getAnnotation(...)` helpers, preserving both tests and their assertions, then ran the exact Forge finalization command to a stable successful pass.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the coordinate-scoped diff, local gate evidence, compile-fix API/package moves, test behavior, metadata format, index integrity, and resolved statistics. Dynamic-access coverage passes for overall (30/30 to 38/38), reflection (29/29 to 37/37), and resources (1/1 to 1/1). The repaired tree completed the exact Forge finalizer with all three native-test lanes, metadata validation, Spotless, Checkstyle, and regenerated statistics, and the successful stable pass made no further publishable change.
